name: Fourier’s heat equation and trigonometric series
description: Fourier described heat diffusion mathematically and used trigonometric series to represent temperature distributions.

impact.note: Used by physicists, engineers and mathematicians everywhere, it gave a new way to analyse functions, and signal processing, analysis and quantum theory all came to rest on it.
